scope: Fabricated legal lifecycle fixture; not ethical-wall, clinical, regulatory or managed-service qualification
decisions: Original domain metadata retained completely in original-domain-sources.json; it is not silently interpreted as executable validation.
TableSpec INTEGER explicitly selects int4; unconstrained VARCHAR explicitly selects native text/C collation. No general TableSpec-native equivalence is claimed.
Native FK semantics choose NO ACTION update, RESTRICT delete, immediate nondeferrable; source FK metadata is preserved.
Matters SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE require visible assigned membership; membership writes denied to ordinary and batch roles.
Clients are explicitly public synthetic reference reads; billing data is readable only by a trusted billing_admin group.
Batch may SELECT and INSERT matters but cannot UPDATE/DELETE them. This is a command boundary, not retry idempotency.
The original matters/client FK is deliberately delayed to exercise added constraints; review_state and database_role are explicit fixture additions.
Default review state keeps historical immutable seeds valid for fresh installation. Evolution removes the default during ADD, performs the explicit backfill, then installs DEFAULT and NOT NULL.
